item.title: Lengthy surface cracking along footpath/cyclepath, 19th August
item.description:
Several lengthy stretches of cracked surface along the footpath/cyclepath that runs adjacent to the dual carriageway near to the lorry stop on the A417. I think it's also known as the Elmbridge bypass. Some of the cracks are wide enough for a bike tyre to enter, making it quite dangerous. Also, the surface paint splitting the footpath/cyclepath & indicating bike or pedestrian have long since faded, making it unclear as to which side to be on

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): A417, Elmbridge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Lack of signage instructing cyclists to dismount, 19th August
item.description:
Cyclists and those using e-scooters are riding through Church Piece pedestrian precinct on a daily basis. This is hazardous to the many pedestrians who use Church piece, particularly during school drop off and pick up when dozens of young families walk through the precinct. We understand that historically there were signs in place instructing cyclists to dismount but seem to have since been removed. Please could suitable signage be reinstalled to ensure the precinct remains for pedestrian use only.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Church Piece, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Yellow Parking Lines on Church Road, 19th August
item.description:
The yellow lines on Church Road where it meets Leckhampton Road are no longer visible. An increasing number of vehicles are now parking here illegally due the lines not being visible. Traffic has increased greatly due to the roadworks on Shurdington Road and the A417 closures. When cars are parked either side it effectively turns the road into a single lane meaning increased congestion and irritating traffic noise from car horns. This was reported in February 2026 and whilst GCC said it would be sorted the issue remains.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Church Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
